reviews.text:
Dr Kimmel and Lorraine
Thank you for being the most compassionate, patient, and brilliant veterinarian and assistant  we could ever ask for. You do not just treat animals; you listen to them, you understand them, and you ease their fear. I will never forget when you stepped up for Mable's late-night, last-minute weekend surgery during that terrible snow storm. When we were panicked and terrified, your swift action and calm spirit completely put our minds at ease. What moved us most was how you stayed by her side through the storm, ensuring she felt safe, loved, and comforted until she was finally ready to come home. You didn't hesitate to sacrifice your own comfort or rest to save her, and your deep dedication gave us our girl back.
Beyond everything you have done for Mable, I am endlessly grateful for your unwavering support with my many desperate rescue animals. Your dedication to helping me rehabilitate and care for them so they can be safely rehomed is nothing short of incredible. You truly are an angel on earth, and words could never fully express how blessed and grateful I am to have you in our lives and watching over my animals.
What makes you so extraordinary is that you care for the owners just as much as the patients. In our darkest, most anxious moments, you are always there to comfort us, reassuring us that you will do whatever it takes to help our beloved pets. Whether it means working on your days off or staying way past closing time, you never rush and you never give up.
Thank you for your tireless care, your late-night worry, and the profound love you bring to your work every single day. You are a true hero to our family, to Mable, and to every pet  that crosses your path.
With all our gratitude,
Dolores and Mable

My bad little dog actually bit the owner and they were still very nice to her, everything was explained, we were given several options on what direction we could take, he had our meds on hand and explained how to give them to the dog, everyone was friendly, and stayed open late to take care of my dog

I cannot thank Terry animal hospital enough. I came home to find my rabbit with a severe wound. The hospital was closed for the day for some minor constructionbut took me anyway because it was an emergency. My rabbits all better and I'm so thankful

Dr Kimmel went above and beyond for my cat ,I dont know what we would have done with out his help I've never known a vet who would have done what Dr Kennel has done ,He cared so much for her,He treated her like she was his own very patient explaining every treatment .Came in on his day off and stayed with her for hours.
I've never met a Veterinarian with such compassion for an animal. Any animal. Takes his time With each animal during your visit. Reasonably priced.
Best ANMINAL DR

Dr Kimmel is the most caring vet we know. We have used him for 3 of our dogs over many years. Most recently for our Lulu that was just diagnosed with diabetes. Dr Kimmel goes above and beyond and its very obvious that he loves his patients. Very grateful to have him to take care of our fur baby.

I would recommend Dr. Kimmel for anyone in need of answers and/or help with their fur babies. My great grandmom who is 86 years old adores her cats and would be lost without them and Dr. Kimmel saved Angel's life (ggmom cat). Back in December/January we realized a lump on her back leg which at first seemed to us to just be a dislocated hip or some kind of injury that was not life threatening, but after going to a vet, just by looking at her they said it was cancer. We left and checked another vet for a second opinion and they said the same thing, which we knew to be true by then due to the way it was beginning to look, but that vet could not do the surgery. My aunt recommended Dr. Kimmel, as he takes care of her animals as well, and it was the best choice we have made this far. As the lump progressed and symptoms began to surface more and more each day, any other vet may have declined to do a surgery as severe as she had with the condition she was in and the size and looks of the infected abscess on her back leg and after observation of Angel, he took action right away. For something that we thought was going to be impossible turned out to be a miracle because of him. He was able to remove the whole tumor, removed all dead tissue and bad cells that may have been around the area, unfortunately it resulted in amputation but we knew that walking into surgery, and to everyones knowledge no cancer was able to spread since he took care of it right away after 2ish months of progression before we got into his office. Had we got there sooner he probably could have saved her leg. He answers questions thoroughly, he helps with anything you need big or small, he truly cares about your animals and not a paycheck. He is extremely fair price wise and is amazing all the way through til the end. Thank you Dr. Kimmel and Loraine for all your help this far and we truly appreciate you both! And thank you for keeping this wonderful cat alive, especially for my grandmom!
Love always, the Martin Family!!
Very caring to pet owners and pets.  Very affordable. Dr. Kimmel is very informative!
My cat had a burst abscess that needed to be treated. They fit us in same day.

I would give this guy 10 stars. New dog, had to find a vet. Was very worried about prices and finding a good one. The description of this Vet could not be any more accurate. Super affordable, extremely caring and
knowledgeable, amazing at what he does. Could not recommend enough to anyone looking for a vet. This guy is great!
Great vet visit and really nice experience! I am going to bring all my animals here.

Dr. Kimmel helped me and my fur baby tremendously. I brought Hershey in on a Sunday—outside of regular office hours—due to a urinary blockage. Dr. Kimmel immediately recognized how worried I was and provided the care and support we both needed to feel at ease. He successfully unblocked Hershey and kept me well informed about his overall health throughout his stay.

Although there were some complications following treatment, Dr. Kimmel went above and beyond by calling every day—even after hours—to check in and ease my stress. He truly cared about both Hershey’s physical recovery and my emotional well-being. Thanks to his dedication and compassion, Hershey is now back to normal and thriving, as if nothing ever happened. I couldn’t be more grateful for Dr. Kimmel and his entire team.
Dr. Kimmel and Lorraine are the absolute best people.  They truly care for our pets.

Very honest veterinarian. You gave me some good advice. He could have  just pump my dog with some medications and told me he'll be fine, but actually he won't be because I already did this twice. With other veterinarians But I really want to find out the root cause of his allergies.
Dr. Ken Kimmel has high hopes for my 12 year-old pup's torn CCL with Adequan Therapy. I am hopeful too! Dr. Ken is kind and compassionate and he truly loves animals.

I love it here, this guy truly cares about the animals, not about how much money he can make off of you and your sick animal. He takes his time and explains everything to you, makes sure your pet feels at ease and treats you like your pet is the only pet in the world!

Dr. Kimmel is unquestionably the best vet around.
He cared for three dogs we have had over the past 30 years.
He KNOWS veterinary medicine. He is thorough in his history taking
and physical examination and he explains everything to pet parents.

Our 12-13 year old rescue Coco developed kidney disease and Dr. Kimmel's care gave us two extra years to love her.
Last week we felt like Coco's end was near and we took her to see Dr. Kimmel who compassionately confirmed that it was time.
It was a sad time, but Dr. Kimmel assured us that we were saving Coco from future pain and discomfort and he put Coco to rest In a caring,
painless and respectful manner.

Do not hesitate to take your four-legged loved ones to Dr. Kimmel.
You will know after the first visit that you made the right decision.
Good caring people, make sure you lock the door behind you for everyone's protection including Animals,   had to learn that... and the thought is correct🫡💪👍✌️☺️ …

Dr Kimmel is not only a very compassionate and knowledgeable vet, he is also very personable and friendly. He and his wife are great. Took such good care of my cat and really understand how much she means to me. He is very thorough and doesn't try to rush you out or run up an unnecessary bill. He has my business for life (or until he retires lol)
Dr. Kimmel is the best!!!

Brought our 24 lb cat here. Dr. kimmel was very knowledgeable, gave a thorough exam with all the required shots and informed us of all the dangers a large cat faces. He advised us as to  the best solution for fleas and ticks given our situation. I wholeheartedly recommend this animal hosital without reservation!
They couldn't tell me a price for fixing my cat because they didn't see her
He's been taking care of my dog Max since he was a year old, now he's an old man (Max not the doc). He's the best vet an animal could have!

After another vet I will not name (*coughBreescough*) failed to do anything to help my extremely sick cat I called Terry Animal Hospital. They got me in within a day and Dr. Kimmel provided excellent treatment for my cat. My cat started making improvements the next morning.

I have always heard wonderful things about Dr Kimmel but never had the pleasure of meeting him . I had an after hrs emergency with my dog Winnie I called on a whim and Dr Kimmel answered the phone . I told him what was going on w Winnie she had injured her eye and I was very concerned with not having her seen asap . He had told me to bring her around to the office and he could see her . He was so compassionate and caring and truly went out of his way to accommodate me as a new patient and especially after hrs . You won’t find that in a Veterinarian anymore I promise you that . The alternative would have been going to an emergency animal hospital and paying high fees for less then compassionate care . I will forever be grateful for Dr Kimmel seeing me and helping my Winnie . I would recommend Dr Kimmel to anyone who needs a caring kind Veterinarian you won’t be disappointed!
This place is amazing, Dr. Kenneth R. Kimmel and his lovely wife made my pet and my family feel at home he’s a real animal lover and it’s an amazing Doctor
Good doctor and staff.  Dr.  Kimmel explained everything and worked with me to take care of my pet. The prices he charged were very reasonable.

This was my first trip here, and I wish it had been under better circumstances. I needed to have my cat put down, and they were extremely compassionate. He asked some questions, but once it was clear, nothing could be done for him they pivoted to being supportive and caring.  When I find a new baby to take into my home, I will be coming here first for a local vet.

Thank you for everything.

Ken is the best vet out there - the other night I came home my brother in law said something was wrong with my dog when I came home I could tell something was really wrong - something was nagging at me but I didn’t know why - I called Terry animal hospital cause that’s where I’ve been taking coco since we got her 18 months ago and ken said to come over he would look at her though but was after hours and when he saw her he believed she had a seizure - it’s when it clicked this is how my previous dog had acted AFTER  he had a seizure - I could tell that slowly she was “ coming out of it “ and we had come home post seizure.
I was impressed - my last vet - I wasn’t too thrilled with for a few reasons - I’ll never take any pet that I have to any other vet I completely trust his judgment I had a feeling he’d know what was wrong with her. I highly recommend Terry animal hospital - sometimes they’re really busy and you may have to wait but if you care for your pets the time is nothing compared to going to any other vet that doesn’t seem to quite care the way Ken does.
Dr. Kimmel is knowledgeable, patient, and detailed in his explanation...

I called on a holiday afternoon because my cat needed attention and they gave me an appointment that day.  The doctor was very gentle and thorough and explained everything clearly.  Easily the best vet visit for me as a pet owner in 40 years.

Dr. Kimmel and Lorraine were there for me and my wife’s hardest decision. We said goodbye to our best friend, They were very empathetic and honest with us given the situation. I appreciate you both making something so heartbreaking feel comforting.we will miss our best friend but thank you for helping us in our time of need

We unfortunately had to make the hardest decision any pet owner had to make and say goodbye to our sweet girl on 11.4.2024. I spent majority of my morning scrambling trying to find a vet in our budget and found this lovely practice. The wife/receptionist immediately got me even though it pushed them past closing hours. They were very kind and shared their stories of their pet with us to give us comfort. They were beyond compassionate and kind during her final moments. I’m sad we met them under these circumstances but beyond grateful for them. They truly take their time to care for each pet individually. Thank you so much, you have our gratitude.
Great doctor very friendly, really knows what he's doing, reception is very friendly also.
Very nice man , gave us genuine information . Straight honest answers . I wouldn’t go to ANY other place . Very honorable service thank you very much .

When you take your dog to a emergency vet cause you think your dog is dying and in pain and they send you home with a anti inflammatory medication and tell you your dog has Lyme disease and never calls you back with any results. Also they charge you $1,400 dollars!  You call Terry animal hospital where he tells you your pet probably would’ve died if you didn’t get him help. Turns out my dog had a infection in his spine that almost killed him , I can’t thank terry animal hospital enough for saving my dogs life and saving me an additional $1,000 dollars . Definitely worth the visit

Awesome Vet!! Took my 14 yr old cat, who is afraid of everyone, and she just laid there and let him do what he had too. They are very friendly and personable!!
Dr Kimmel took his time & made sure we understood what he was doing & what we have to do moving forward.
Highly recommend!!
Thank you!!
Always there when you need him one of the most reliable doctors
The most caring Vet I've ever met, He's very professional and passionate about his patients and work. I'll never take another Animal to another Vet ever again.

This, that is an absolute gem in the rough!!!  I was in desperate. I Needed to find an emergency vet for my 70 Day pregnant female pug that needed to give birth because she was way overdue. I knew that my first time mother pug was way …

Heard amazing things about this Vet & friend had a multiple hour long surgery on her 15 yr old Chihuahua who had a severe tooth infection. Dr spent several hrs to do an extremely difficult surgery & her dog is doing fantastic!
